checks.name: no strategy chosen before the gate passes

program.def:
def card(work):
    robots = 'User-agent: *\nDisallow: /private/\nCrawl-delay: 4\n'
    save(work, 'robots.txt', robots)
    sample = 'Contact dr.ali@example.org. © 2026 Clinic, all rights reserved.'
    ok = legality_gate(robots, 'https://site.test/news/1', 'kosif', False, False, sample)
    blocked = legality_gate(robots, 'https://site.test/private/x', 'kosif', False, False, '')
    auth = legality_gate(robots, 'https://site.test/news/1', 'kosif', False, True, '')
    save(work, 'gate.json', {'ok': ok, 'blocked': blocked, 'auth': auth})
    return [eq('public allowed page passes', ok['passed'], True), eq('robots-disallowed path fails gate', blocked['passed'], False), eq('authenticated content fails gate', auth['passed'], False), eq('polite rate from Crawl-delay 4', ok['rate_per_s'], 0.25), eq('PII and copyright flagged', ok['flags'], ['PII', 'copyright']), truth('no strategy chosen before the gate passes', blocked['strategy'] is None)]

title: Database views over notes with Obsidian Bases

program.def:
def card(work):
    base = {'filters': {'and': ['file.hasTag("book")', 'file.inFolder("Reading")']}, 'formulas': {'age_days': '(now() - file.ctime).days.round(0)', 'label': '\'Status: "\' + status + \'"\''}, 'views': [{'type': 'table', 'name': 'By author', 'groupBy': {'property': 'author'}, 'order': ['file.name', 'formula.age_days'], 'summaries': {'formula.age_days': 'Average'}}]}
    good = yaml.safe_dump(base, allow_unicode=True, sort_keys=False)
    save(work, 'Books.base', good)
    bad_base = dict(base, views=[dict(base['views'][0], order=['formula.score'])])
    bad = yaml.safe_dump(bad_base, sort_keys=False)
    rg, rb = (validate_base(good), validate_base(bad))
    title = yaml.safe_dump({'title': 'Note: {draft} #1'})
    save(work, 'validation.json', {'good': rg, 'bad': rb})
    return [eq('valid base passes', rg['ok'], True), eq('undefined formula.score caught', rb['missing_formulas'], ['score']), truth('duration read via .days before rounding', '.days.round' in base['formulas']['age_days']), eq('string with : { } # round-trips quoted', yaml.safe_load(title)['title'], 'Note: {draft} #1'), truth('embed syntax', '![[Books.base#By author]]'.startswith('![['))]

title: Recognition over recall in pickers and menus

checks.name: hidden options + Enter value flagged on country

program.def:
def card(work):
    countries = ['Egypt', 'Jordan', 'Saudi Arabia', 'Bahrain', 'Qatar', 'Oman', 'Morocco', 'Arabic Republic']
    res = combobox(countries, 'ar', recents=['Qatar'])
    fields = [{'name': 'country', 'kind': 'choice', 'options_shown': False, 'placeholder': 'Enter value'}, {'name': 'password', 'kind': 'password'}, {'name': 'city', 'kind': 'choice', 'options_shown': True, 'placeholder': 'e.g. Cairo'}]
    issues = audit_fields(fields)
    save(work, 'recognition_audit.json', {'combobox': res, 'issues': issues})
    return [eq('filtered matches, recents first', res, ['Qatar', 'Arabic Republic', 'Saudi Arabia']), eq('hidden options + Enter value flagged on country', [i[0] for i in issues], ['country', 'country']), truth('password keeps recall', all((i[0] != 'password' for i in issues)))]
